# Strides Type and F-Order Computation Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Define `Strides<D>` in `src/layout/strides.rs` and implement the canonical F-order stride computation utilities, including overflow checking and zero-stride detection.

**Architecture:** `Strides<D>` is the layout-owned carrier for explicit stride metadata. `Dimension` continues to own only shape/rank semantics. F-order stride calculation is centralized in `layout/` and returns structured errors on overflow or rank mismatches. All `Strides<D>` surfaces must consistently use `D: Dimension`, and raw-slice conversion must use the canonical `Dimension::try_from_slice` entrypoint.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, `crate::dimension::Dimension`, `crate::error::XenonError`

**Design Docs:** `design/06-layout.md` §5.2a, §5.3, §5.7, §6.2a, `design/02-dimension.md` §5.1, `design/01-architecture.md` §1.5, §11, `design/00-coding.md` §4.2, §5.1

**Prerequisites:** W6T1 and W3T1 must be complete.

### Task 1: Implement `Strides<D>` and the F-order helpers

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/layout/strides.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the complete type and helper implementation**

Replace the placeholder in `src/layout/strides.rs` with the following content:

```rust
use crate::dimension::Dimension;
use crate::error::XenonError;

pub struct Strides<D: Dimension> {
    strides: D,
}

impl<D: Dimension> Strides<D> {
    pub fn new(strides: D) -> Self {
        Self { strides }
    }

    pub fn from_slice(slice: &[usize]) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
        let strides = D::try_from_slice(slice).map_err(|_| XenonError::InvalidLayout {
            operation: "Strides::from_slice".into(),
            storage_kind: "stride metadata".into(),
            shape: Vec::new(),
            strides: slice.to_vec(),
            offset: 0,
            storage_len: 0,
            reason: "slice rank does not match dimension type".into(),
        })?;
        Ok(Self::new(strides))
    }

    pub fn f_contiguous(shape: &D) -> Result<Self, XenonError> {
        compute_f_strides(shape)
    }

    pub fn try_stride(&self, axis: usize) -> Result<usize, XenonError> {
        self.as_slice().get(axis).copied().ok_or_else(|| XenonError::InvalidAxis {
            operation: "Strides::try_stride".into(),
            axis,
            ndim: self.as_slice().len(),
            shape: self.as_slice().to_vec(),
        })
    }

    pub fn iter(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &usize> {
        self.as_slice().iter()
    }

    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[usize] {
        self.strides.slice()
    }
}

pub fn compute_f_strides<D: Dimension>(shape: &D) -> Result<Strides<D>, XenonError> {
    let mut values = Vec::with_capacity(shape.ndim());
    let mut cumulative = 1usize;

    for &extent in shape.slice() {
        values.push(cumulative);
        cumulative = cumulative.checked_mul(extent).ok_or_else(|| XenonError::InvalidLayout {
            operation: "compute_f_strides".into(),
            storage_kind: "f_order".into(),
            shape: shape.slice().to_vec(),
            strides: values.clone(),
            offset: 0,
            storage_len: 0,
            reason: "stride computation overflow".into(),
        })?;
    }

    Strides::<D>::from_slice(&values)
}

pub fn has_zero_stride<D: Dimension>(strides: &Strides<D>) -> bool {
    strides.iter().any(|&stride| stride == 0)
}
```
